# Narrative contract

## One-sentence thesis

Gauge-covariant staple dispersion is exactly residual local link energy, and
on the smallest open four-dimensional block every nonzero centered star
operation has a strictly positive, exactly certified external-curvature cost.

## Reader promise

The paper provides one nonlinear geometric comparison, one exact dependent
Gaussian law, one general minimum-spill construction, and one exact finite
block spectrum.  Proofs and certificate logic are self-contained.

## Forbidden implications

- no claim that the result is a new smearing or flow algorithm;
- no claim that Fréchet/Karcher means are new;
- no nonlinear physical-measure tail without its stated comparison premises;
- no scale-uniform repair, basin entry, continuum construction, or mass gap;
- no use of “first” or “previously unknown” before external citation review.

## Narrative order

Phenomenon (shared staples) -> invariant residual energy -> nonlinear geometry
-> dependent Gaussian reference -> reverse lift problem -> exact spillover ->
repair accounting -> representational interpretation -> limitations.
